description: One-year half-hourly profiles of demand, PV generation, and EV charging for a household in London, UK is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ahmed A.Raouf Mohamed, Robert Best (Queen’s University Belfast). This file contains one-year measurements of demand, Electric vehicle charging, and PV generation for a household in London, UK. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
